lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Vanakkam sir, naan Kaveri Finance la irundhu pesaren. Karthik Subramanian sir kooda pesalaama?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you sir. Indha call quality purpose kaaga record aagudhu. Verification kaaga, unga loan account oda last four digits sollunga please?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ஒரு நிமிஷம்... six eight one nine.
lines.roman: Oru nimisham... six eight one nine.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you sir. Unga two-wheeler loan EMI, four thousand two hundred fifty rupees, November third due date irundhuchu. Adhu innum pending la irukku.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ஆமா sorry, மறந்தே போச்சு. Native போயிருந்தேன், அம்மாக்கு உடம்பு சரியில்ல.
lines.roman: Aama sorry, marandhe pochu. Native poyirundhen, ammaakku odambu sariyilla.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Aiyo, sorry to hear sir. Amma ippo nalla irukaangala? Andha travel naala dhaan payment miss aachaa, illa vera edhavadhu financial issue irukka?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: இப்போ பரவாயில்ல. Money problem ஒண்ணும் இல்ல, just மறந்துட்டேன்.
lines.roman: Ippo paravaayilla. Money problem onnum illa, just marandhutten.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Glad to hear that sir. Just for your information, grace period mudinja appuram five hundred rupees late fee varum, and late payment credit score la reflect aagum.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: அப்போ இன்னைக்கே pay பண்ணிடறேன். GPay ல பண்ணலாமா?
lines.roman: Appo innaikke pay pannidaren. GPay la pannalaamaa?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Kandippa sir. Unga registered mobile number ending four four two one ku oru payment link anuppuren, adhula UPI moolama pay pannalaam.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: சரி, link வந்துடுச்சு... பண்ணிட்டேன். Success னு காட்டுது.
lines.roman: Seri, link vandhuduchu... pannitten. Success nu kaattudhu.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you sir, four thousand two hundred fifty rupees payment received aagiduchu. Receipt SMS la oru mani neratthula varum. Adutha EMI December third, auto-debit set pannikalaama?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Nandri Karthik sir, amma seekiram gunamaaganum. Nalla naal.

analysis.outcomeRationale: Customer paid the full EMI of ₹4,250 via the UPI payment link during the call and the agent confirmed receipt.
analysis.summary: Borrower missed the 3 November two-wheeler EMI while travelling to care for his unwell mother. Agent verified identity, checked for underlying financial stress, and collected the full EMI on the call through a payment link.
analysis.observations: Strong early-bucket call: recording disclosure and account verification before dues, a genuine empathy check that also probed for financial stress, and in-call payment with receipt confirmation.
analysis.improvements: Auto-debit pitch was a good instinct but should explain the benefit (no missed dates, no late fee) rather than just asking.

op_greet_company.rationale: Greeted with Vanakkam and named Kaveri Finance in the opening line.

op_rpc_verify.rationale: Asked for the last four digits of the loan account before discussing dues.

op_recording_disclosure.rationale: Told the customer the call is recorded for quality purposes.

pr_state_dues.rationale: Stated the ₹4,250 EMI and the 3 November due date.

pr_late_fee_info.rationale: Explained the ₹500 late fee and credit-score impact factually.

ds_reason_delay.rationale: Asked whether the miss was due to travel or an underlying financial issue.

ds_empathy.rationale: Asked after the mother's health before continuing.

cp_no_threats.rationale: Consequences framed as information, no coercion.

cp_respectful.rationale: Warm, polite tone throughout, including the closing wish for the mother.

cp_no_third_party.rationale: Loan discussed only after the borrower confirmed account digits.

cl_ptp_secured.rationale: Full amount paid during the call, superseding a promise.

cl_payment_mode.rationale: Payment link to registered mobile via UPI agreed and used.

cl_recap.rationale: Confirmed amount received, receipt timing and the next EMI date.
